title: Vibrant Spicy Malaysian Baby Squid Noodles
description: A jammy and springy Malaysian dish featuring baby squid and nuka-pickle, perfect for a monsoon evening. This gluten-free-friendly recipe is a must-try for seafood lovers.

ingredients.name: baby squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the baby squid and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the nuka-pickle, coconut milk, fish sauce, and lime juice, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the squid is cooked through.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and drain.
Add the cooked noodles to the wok or frying pan and stir to combine with the squid mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve immediately.
